title: Recipient evidence and rejection discipline
purpose: Avoid treating casual comments, support scripts, or proactive filters as final rejection authority.
coreRule: Recipient acceptance should be evaluated from known written instructions, official route requirements, published recipient rules, or documented rejection/acceptance evidence. A phone comment, email request, or informal support answer is not automatically a final rejection.
proactiveRejectionDefinition: A proactive rejection is an earlier filter saying a document will not be accepted before the actual approving authority reviews a submitted document.
failureSignals: changes a clean route based only on a phone comment
uses ask the recipient as a vague escape hatch
does not identify whether the person rejecting has approval authority
treats platform queue filtering as recipient law
publicReplyPosture: Ask for written rejection evidence and escalation details. Do not fight shadows; identify the authority and the actual reason.
